summary: A dataset table reload run from a macro no longer reports a timeout while it is still running, and now says when it had to rebuild the dataset index.
details: The Import ResQ Reserving Class macro allows the reload 30 seconds, but the app gave up after a fixed 10 seconds and reported 'Timed out waiting for Project Instance' even though the table loaded moments later. The app now waits for as long as the caller asked.

Reloading the dataset table re-checks the reserving-class folder and rebuilds index.json whenever the folder no longer matches it, which reads every sidecar and method file. Over a network share that is the difference between an instant reload and a slow one.
The status bar and the macro's completion dialog now report when a rebuild happened, why, and how long it took, so a slow reload is no longer an unexplained wait.
